root_causes: A model-name allowlist omitted V4.1 fast-mode controls; all models now receive one bounded policy.
Loose output instructions allowed source packets and planning material to be echoed into the answer.
Models could output subject labels outside the atlas taxonomy; output schema now enumerates allowed identifiers.
GLM returned reasoning despite enable_thinking=false and consumed the entire compact review budget; a separate 1024-token reserve is now included.
Transport cleanup awaited an unbounded reader.cancel promise after watchdogs were cleared.
Incomplete or interrupted final checks concealed usable work; they now expose a partial map without a completed-check badge.
The streaming graph preserved an initial off-canvas viewport; new personal nodes now fit until the user takes control.

shared_policy.thinking_note: Some models still reason. thinking_disabled in receipts describes the requested setting; reasoning_characters records received reasoning without retaining its text.
shared_policy.explicit_optional_parameter_rejection_on: HTTP 400/422, at most two adjustments, session-local capability memory.
shared_policy.final_check: Exactly one unambiguous verdict for each insight and connection; missing verdicts cannot earn completed status.
shared_policy.interrupted_generation: Only whole, source-linked records are recovered and reviewed; missing coverage remains a gap.

cumulative_preview_qa_only.billing_note: Provider-reported usage, sometimes received before interruption, is not final billed usage. Missing usage does not imply a free request. live_qa.delivery_note: No provider, prompt, evidence-validation or retrieval changes followed these final live runs. Subsequent graph framing was checked by offline import, inspection and export of every final map.

limitations: All six delivered-policy PECVD maps completed the machine evidence check but retained zero supported connections. They are inspectable research drafts, not complete ancestry reconstructions.

Qwen hit the 150-second generation deadline; six whole insights were recovered and reviewed without replaying generation. GLM planning timed out; bounded question-derived follow-ups retained progress.
Five model IDs were live-tested; other models have shared bounds and controlled compatibility tests, not a claim of universal live certification.
Provider availability and latency vary. Bounds terminate the wait and preserve usable work; they do not guarantee every request produces scientifically useful content.
Source coverage is bounded to abstracts and atlas explanations. The common-source rule can omit valid cross-paper connections.
Published coverage remains 152 populated topics of 154 registered, with 2667 insights and 2233 relations. Per-subject expansion targets remain unmet.
No qualified human audit was performed. Model checks can share mistakes and do not verify scientific priority.
Tests ran on this Mac with desktop and mobile-emulated Chrome. Windows, Linux, physical phones and production deployment were not tested in this preview.
Combined process RSS was approximately 1.07 GiB; the sum may double-count shared pages and includes the long-running reader. It is slightly above the approximate 1 GB target.
